settings.removeText: {{name}} ba zai sami damar shiga wannan fili ba kuma. Ayyukansa suna nan a allo, ba mai ɗauka.
settings.repositoryText: Ma'ajin GitHub yana kawo pull request ɗinsa zuwa shafin Bita; ɗaukar ma'aikata yana nuna aikin cikin waɗanda ke neman mutane.
settings.repositoryTextMember: Mai aikin yana haɗa ma'aji kuma yana faɗin ko aikin yana ɗaukar mutane.
settings.repositoryHint: Ma'aji na jama'a: ana karanta pull request ɗinsa kowane minti goma.
settings.recruitingText: Ana nuna ayyukansa da ke buɗe a cikin sanarwa da baje-koli.
settings.leaveText: Ba za ka sami damar shiga wannan fili ba kuma; ayyukanka za su jira sabon mai ɗauka.
settings.leaveConfirmText: Za ka iya sake neman ɗaya daga cikin ayyukanta daga baya.
